stem.text: Four drops of 1-chlorobutane, 1-bromobutane and 1-iodobutane are put separately into three test-tubes containing $1.0\ \text{cm}^3$ of aqueous silver nitrate at $60\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. In each case, a hydrolysis reaction occurs.
$\text{R}$ represents $\text{C}_4\text{H}_9$ and $\text{X}$ represents the halogen atom.
The rate of formation of cloudiness in the test-tubes is in the order $\text{RCl} < \text{RBr} < \text{RI}$.

A.text: The bond energy of $\text{R–X}$ decreases from $\text{RCl}$ to $\text{RI}$.

B.text: The first ionisation energy of the halogen decreases from $\text{Cl}$ to $\text{I}$.

C.text: The solubility of $\text{AgX(s)}$ decreases from $\text{AgCl}$ to $\text{AgI}$.

D.text: The $\text{R–X}$ bond polarity decreases from $\text{RCl}$ to $\text{RI}$.
